answer: Operator Liability Pool: each registered agent wallet draws from an operator-owned pool covering dispute payouts. Sybil clusters, once correlated by shared funding paths, trigger pool depletion: payouts hit the operator's pool, not individual wallets. An attacker farming identities in a quiet haven loses the whole pool per cluster, and each new cluster needs a fresh pool. Correlation runs across the agent ocean of transaction graphs, with a trellis of shared-address edges exposing clusters. Cost: one full pool per cluster, plus loss of all prior pools.
